brief: High-protein, low-sugar kid-style cereal for adults. $39 for a 4-pack, subscribe and save. Looking for gym-goers and nostalgic millennials.

profile.business_summary: High-protein, low-sugar kid-style cereal for adults sold via a direct-to-consumer subscription model.

relevant_tags.why: Cereal is a shelf-stable pantry staple.
Cereal is a core grocery product.
Offers a 'subscribe and save' purchase model.
High-protein, low-sugar formulation targets health-conscious consumers.

persona_conflicts.evidence: Kid-style cereal, even if high-protein and low-sugar, may be perceived as a novelty or processed food by strict wellness optimizers.

persona_conflicts.conflict: disinterested_in luxury-only messaging / high price sensitivity

note_signals.why: Late-night traffic spike and impulse-friendly nature align well with cereal as a convenient snack.

Users actively spending on self-care and fitness align with the high-protein, health-conscious profile.
